meta.title: Add EnableDefaultItems=false optimization for restore operations
meta.body_summary: Improve dotnet restore performance by automatically adding EnableDefaultItems=false to MSBuild arguments, aiming to reduce evaluation from ~45s to ~300ms on large projects.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot added EnableDefaultItems=false optimization; closed by maintainer with 'we need something more comprehensive', no performance evidence or review.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 248 changed lines, this is a small edit concentrated in two source files and a new test file. As a targeted build-step performance PR, it was closed rather than merged because the maintainer wanted a more comprehensive solution, suggesting the change was deemed too narrow in scope.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainer baronfel closed the PR stating they need something more comprehensive, indicating that the simple EnableDefaultItems=false addition was not sufficient as a performance fix; likely a broader solution is required.
review_details.performance_claim: Reduce restore evaluation time from ~45 seconds to ~300ms on projects with large file counts by disabling default item globbing.
review_details.rejection_signals: Maintainer closed with comment 'we need something more comprehensive', rejecting the narrow approach without specific performance evidence request.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: MSBuild property injection during restore is a build-system optimization; the PR was closed because the maintainer deemed the approach too simplistic, indicating that the agent's solution may not cover all restore paths or edge cases.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark or profiling evidence provided; only narrative claims with expected impact numbers but no before/after measurement.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed without merge after 9 days; maintainer comment indicates desire for a more comprehensive fix.

core_change_summary.description: Added Constants.AddRestoreOptimizations method that inserts EnableDefaultItems=false into MSBuild arguments if not already set, applied in RestoreCommand.CreateForwarding and RestoringCommand.GetSeparateRestoreCommand.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Test file (186 lines) documents expected behavior.
change_trajectory: Initial commit: Add RestoreCommand optimization logic and unit tests.
Second commit: Additional test documenting optimization scope.
Maintainer closed PR after 9 days without formal review, citing need for comprehensive solution.

review_signals.summary: Closing as we need something more comprehensive.
